HR Service Specialist (w/m) 60-100%
Bewerben
Arbeite im Herzen des Gesundheitswesens und werde Teil des #teamBENU !
Jeden Tag haben wir bei PHOENIX Pharma Switzerland eine wichtige Aufgabe: Millionen von Menschen mit Medikamenten und Gesundheitsprodukten zu versorgen. Mit unserem Team aus 1000 engagierten Mitarbeitern sorgen wir dafür, dass diese Produkte zuverlässig und kontinuierlich in der ganzen Schweiz vertrieben werden. Unsere verschiedenen Geschäftseinheiten leisten einen aktiven Beitrag zur Gesundheit, und hier kommt deine Rolle voll zum Tragen. Unser Erfolg beruht auf der Professionalität und dem Engagement unserer Mitarbeitenden, die unsere Unternehmenskultur verkörpern. Be the heartbeat of healthcare.
HR Service Specialist (w/m) 60–100%
Suchst du einen Job, bei dem jeder Tag anders ist? Dann suche nicht weiter! Hier schätzen wir dein Engagement und deine Fähigkeiten.
Das Herzstück deiner Arbeit:
In deiner Funktion als HR Service Specialist (w/m) 60-100% bist du verantwortlich für:
- Sicherstellen der vollständigen Betreuung des Mitarbeiterlebenszyklus, von der Einstellung bis zum Austritt.
- Verantwortung für die Lohnverarbeitung eines definierten Mitarbeiterportfolios, inklusive Bearbeitung der Variablen und Vorbereitung der Daten für die Auszahlung.
- Übernahme des Absenzenmanagements sowie Betreuung der Sozialversicherungen (Meldungen, Nachverfolgung, Koordination und Monitoring der Fälle).
- Gewährleistung der Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit der HR-Daten in den internen Systemen.
- Erstellung von Berichten und Statistiken für die Finanzabteilung (HR Controlling).
- Durchführung der Kontenabstimmungen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Accounting-Abteilung.
- Unterstützung der Führungskräfte bei der Vorbereitung und Nachverfolgung von HR-Gesprächen sowie Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Onboardings und Offboardings.
- Aktive Mitarbeit an HR-Projekten, insbesondere bei der Optimierung von Prozessen, Tools und Systemen.
Was unser Herz höher schlagen lässt:
- Kaufmännische Ausbildung, ergänzt durch ein Zertifikat als HR-Fachfrau/HR-Fachmann HRSE und/oder durch den eidgenössischen Fachausweis in Human Resources (Option A).
- Mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der HR-Administration und in der Lohnverarbeitung.
- Prozessorientierung und ausgeprägtes Detailbewusstsein, fundierte HR-Fachkompetenz sowie eine sehr gute Prioritäten- und Terminkontrolle.
- Digitale Kompetenzen oder Kenntnisse im Bereich künstliche Intelligenz im HR sind ein echtes Plus.
- Eine zuverlässige, lösungsorientierte, proaktive und selbstständige Persönlichkeit mit grossem Interesse an administrativen Aufgaben und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office, in HR-Software (Abacus) sowie in Zeiterfassungssystemen (OnTime).
- Idealerweise zweisprachig (Französisch/Deutsch), alternativ muttersprachliche Kompetenz in einer der beiden Sprachen und mindestens Niveau B2 in der anderen. Englisch mindestens Niveau B2.
Was uns am Herzen liegt:
- Eine Branche mit Zukunft: Wir verzeichnen ein starkes Wachstum und sind einer der Marktführer.
- Massgeschneiderte Vorteile: Wir bieten dir 6 Wochen Urlaub und weitere Benefits (Mitarbeitervergünstigungen, flexible Arbeitszeiten etc.).
- Vereinbarkeit von Privat- und Berufsleben: Profitiere von bis zu 20% Mobile Office.
- Weiterbildung: Schliesse dich der PHOENIX Academy an, um Weiterbildungen zu absolvieren, die auf deine Bedürfnisse zugeschnitten sind.
- Karriere: Du hast die Möglichkeit, dich innerhalb der PHOENIX-Gruppe weiterzuentwickeln.
- Teamgeist: Teamspirit ist uns wichtig. Wir fördern diesen mit regelmässigen kleinen und grossen Events.
Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?
Klicke auf den Button unten.
Lass dein Herz für die Gesundheit schlagen und werde Teil des #teamBENU!

·

Regolatore senior (m/f) 80-100 %
Stiamo cercando il nostro futuro collega e i nostri futuri colleghi!
Applicare ora
Lavorare nel cuore della salute e diventare parte di #teamBENU!
Ogni giorno a PHOENIX Pharma Svizzera abbiamo un compito importante: fornire a milioni di persone medicinali e prodotti sanitari. Con il nostro team di 1000 dipendenti dedicati, garantiamo che questi prodotti siano distribuiti in modo affidabile e continuo in tutta la Svizzera. Le nostre varie unità di business danno un contributo attivo alla salute, e questo è dove il vostro ruolo entra in pieno vigore. Il nostro successo si basa sulla professionalità e l'impegno dei nostri dipendenti, che incarnano la nostra cultura aziendale. Sii il cuore della salute.
Regolatore senior (m/f) 80–100 %
Stai cercando un lavoro dove ogni giorno è diverso? Allora non guardare oltre! Qui apprezziamo il vostro impegno e competenze.
Il cuore del vostro lavoro:
- Creare, coordinare e monitorare le previsioni e i budget per tutte le aree di business del PPS (VSG locale, poi Berna).
- Business Partner per le aree centrali di PPS
- Analisi, comprensione e creazione di rendimenti, nonché KPI / dashboard / automazione nelle varie aree di business (ad esempio analisi delle quote di mercato, statistiche del personale, ecc.).
- Creazione di dashboard, automatizzando report e soluzioni BI.
- Coordinare e monitorare le relazioni finanziarie (conti mensili e annuali) nel segmento retail (VSG e Berna) con una visione sintetica e analitica.
- Gestire e gestire progetti che sono una priorità per l'unità e il segmento retail.
Ciò che rende i nostri cuori battere più velocemente:
- Istruzione commerciale superiore (università tecnica, università, ecc.)
- Almeno 4 anni di esperienza in una posizione simile.
- La conoscenza e l'esperienza nel settore retail sono vantaggiose.
- Esperienza di gruppo è un vantaggio
- Spirito imprenditoriale e di squadra, pensiero analitico, iniziativa, azione proattiva e senso di responsabilità.
- Persona dinamica, motivata, affidabile ed efficiente.
- Mastery di strumenti IT comuni: MS Office Suite in particolare Excel (livello avanzato), buona comprensione di ERP (SAP) e la conoscenza degli strumenti BI (Power BI, Power Pivot e).
- Conoscenza finanziaria e contabile (bilancio, G&V, IFRS).
- Esperienza e conoscenza del retail e del lavoro in un grande gruppo.
- Le tue competenze linguistiche in tedesco (B2), francese (B2) e inglese (almeno B2) ti permettono un'adeguata comunicazione scritta e orale con i gruppi target.
Cosa ci interessa:
- Un'industria con un futuro: Stiamo vivendo una forte crescita e siamo uno dei leader di mercato.
- Vantaggi su misura: Vi offriamo 6 settimane di vacanza e altri benefici (benefici del dipendente, ore di lavoro flessibili, ecc.).
- Compatibilità della vita privata e professionale: Vantaggi fino al 20% Mobile Office.
- Formazione continua: Unisciti all'Accademia di PHOENIX per un'ulteriore formazione su misura per le tue esigenze.
- Carriera: Hai la possibilità di svilupparti all'interno del Gruppo PHOENIX.
- Spirito di squadra: lo spirito di squadra è importante per noi. Promuoviamo questo con regolari piccoli e grandi eventi.
Abbiamo avuto il tuo interesse?
Clicca sul pulsante qui sotto.
Lasciate che il vostro cuore batte per la salute e diventa parte di #teamBENU!

Senior Controller (m/f) 80-100 %
We are looking for our future colleague and our future colleagues!
Apply now
Work at the heart of healthcare and become part of #teamBENU!
Every day at PHOENIX Pharma Switzerland we have an important task: to provide millions of people with medicines and health products. With our team of 1000 dedicated employees, we ensure that these products are reliably and continuously distributed throughout Switzerland. Our various business units make an active contribution to health, and this is where your role comes into full force. Our success is based on the professionalism and commitment of our employees, who embody our corporate culture. Be the heartbeat of healthcare.
Senior Controller (m/f) 80–100 %
Are you looking for a job where every day is different? Then look no further! Here we appreciate your commitment and skills.
The heart of your work:
- Create, coordinate and monitor forecasts and budgets for all business areas of PPS (local VSG, then Bern).
- Business Partnering for the central areas of PPS
- Analysis, understanding and creation of income statements as well as KPIs / dashboards / automations in the various business areas (e.g. market share analysis, personnel statistics, etc.).
- Creating dashboards, automating reports and BI solutions.
- Coordinate and monitor financial reports (monthly and annual accounts) in the retail segment (VSG and later Bern) with a synthetic and analytical view.
- Manage and manage projects that are a priority for the unit and retail segment.
What makes our hearts beat faster:
- Higher commercial education (technical college, university, etc.)
- At least 4 years of experience in a similar position.
- Knowledge and experience in the retail sector are beneficial.
- Group experience is an advantage
- Entrepreneurial and team spirit, analytical thinking, initiative, proactive action and a sense of responsibility.
- Dynamic, motivated, reliable and efficient person.
- Mastery of common IT tools: MS Office Suite in particular Excel (advanced level), good understanding of ERP (SAP) and knowledge of BI tools (Power BI, Power Pivot and).
- Financial and accounting knowledge (balance sheet, G&V, IFRS).
- Experience and knowledge of retail and working in a large group.
- Your language skills in German (B2), French (B2) and English (at least B2) allow you adequate written and oral communication with the target groups.
What we care about:
- An industry with a future: We are experiencing strong growth and are one of the market leaders.
- Tailor-made advantages: We offer you 6 weeks of vacation and other benefits (employee benefits, flexible working hours, etc.).
- Compatibility of private and professional life: Benefit from up to 20% Mobile Office.
- Continuing education: Join the PHOENIX Academy for further education tailored to your needs.
- Career: You have the opportunity to develop within the PHOENIX Group.
- Team spirit: Team spirit is important to us. We promote this with regular small and large events.
Did we get your interest?
Click on the button below.
Let your heart beat for health and become part of #teamBENU!

Work in the heart of the healthcare system and become part of the #teamBENU!

Every day at PHOENIX Pharma Switzerland we have an important task: to provide millions of people with medicines and health products. With our team of 1000 dedicated employees, we ensure that these products are reliably and continuously distributed throughout Switzerland. Our various business units make an active contribution to health, and this is where your role comes into full force. Our success is based on the professionalism and commitment of our employees, who embody our corporate culture. Be the heartbeat of healthcare.

Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric(m/f) 80- 100%

As part of a network of 103 pharmacies Join the BI & Data team and participate in the development, architecture and governance of our analytical platform based on Microsoft Fabric.

The heart of your work:

In your role as Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric (m/f) 80 - 100% you are responsible for:

    the conception, construction and continuous development of our modern data platform and data architecture.

  • the development, integration and optimization of scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for data from various source systems.

  • ensuring high data quality through automated validation, monitoring and data governance and data lineage concepts.

  • the administration and optimization of Lakehouses, SQL Analytics and storage structures in terms of performance, scalability and cost.

  • the definition and implementation of strategies for data integration, storage, partitioning and the entire data lifecycle.

  • the documentation of data flows, transformation logics and metadata as well as the continuous maintenance and further development of the data catalogue.

  • ensuring data security, access concepts and efficient use of platform resources.

What makes our heart beat faster:

    You have a degree in computer science, data engineering or a comparable field or have an equivalent professional experience.

    You have at least two to three years of practical experience in data engineering and are enthusiastic about modern data platforms and new technologies.

  • You have in-depth knowledge of PySpark/Python, SQL and Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Notebooks, Pipelines and Dataflows) and know modern data architectures.

    • Ideally, you bring experience in the areas of data modeling, Delta Lake, REST APIs, Git and Data Governance.

    Knowledge in Power BI, especially in the creation of semantic models, dashboards and reports, are a plus.

    You work independently, structured and quality-conscious and enjoy solving complex technical problems.

  • You communicate fluently in German and/or French. Technical English is an advantage.

What we care about:

  • An industry with a future: We are experiencing strong growth and are one of the market leaders.

  • tailor-made advantages: • We offer you 6 weeks of vacation and other benefits (employee benefits, flexible working hours, etc.).

  • Compatibility of private and professional life: Benefit from up to 20% Mobile Office.

  • Further education: Join the PHOENIX Academy for further education tailored to your needs.

  • Career: You have the opportunity to develop further within the PHOENIX Group.

  • Team spirit: Team spirit is important to us. We promote this with regular small and large events.
